title: For those who visit Mallworld
content: Do you guys feel like your dreams are a continuation of the previous dream you had in MallWorld? I've noticed there are a lot of elements that carry over from previous dreams. For instance, I've had dreams of a post-apocalyptic MallWorld, and several of my dreams over a series of nights are me trying to "survive" in this post-apocalyptic world. Has anyone had similar experiences?
